```sql
WITH 
  -- Derive vertical shock range as accel_stats_z_p99 - accel_stats_z_p1
  accel_stats_z_p99_minus_z_p1 AS (
    SELECT 
      timestamp,
      AVG(CASE WHEN behavior = 'aggressive' THEN accel_stats_z_p99 ELSE accel_stats_z_p1 END) AS vertical_shock_range
    FROM 
      bus
    GROUP BY 
      timestamp
  ),
  -- Filter to aggressive behavior
  filtered_accel_stats AS (
    SELECT 
      vertical_shock_range
    FROM 
      accel_stats_z_p99_minus_z_p1
    WHERE 
      behavior = 'aggressive'
  )
  -- Group rows into 5-minute timestamp windows
  -- and return the window with the highest mean vertical shock range
  grouped_accel_stats AS (
    SELECT 
      timestamp,
      AVG(vertical_shock_range) AS mean_vertical_shock_range
    FROM 
      filtered_accel_stats
    GROUP BY 
      timestamp
  )
  -- Rank the grouped rows by mean vertical shock range
  ranked_accel_stats AS (
    SELECT 
      timestamp,
      mean_vertical_shock_range,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mean_vertical_shock_range DESC) AS rank
    FROM 
      grouped_accel_stats
  )
  -- Select the row with the highest mean vertical shock range
  best_accel_stats AS (
    SELECT 
      timestamp,
      mean_vertical_shock_range
    FROM 
      ranked_accel_stats
    ORDER BY 
      mean_vertical_shock_range DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
-- Return the result
SELECT 
  timestamp,
  mean_vertical_shock_range
FROM 
  best_accel_stats;
```
